nights.title: TYSON YOSHI
nights.name: Tyson Yoshi
nights.extract: Ben Cheng Tsun Yin, better known by his stage name Tyson Yoshi, is a Hong Kong singer-songwriter, and MV director. He made his debut in 2018 with his single "To My Queen".

en.who: Tyson Yoshi is the stage name of Ben Cheng Tsun Yin. He is a Hong Kong singer-songwriter and MV director.
facts: Ben Cheng Tsun Yin, better known by his stage name Tyson Yoshi, is a Hong Kong singer-songwriter, and MV director.
He made his debut in 2018 with his single "To My Queen".

de.who: Tyson Yoshi ist der künstlername von Ben Cheng Tsun Yin. er ist ein hongkonger singer-songwriter und mv-regisseur.
facts: Ben Cheng Tsun Yin, besser bekannt unter seinem künstlernamen Tyson Yoshi, ist ein hongkonger singer-songwriter und mv-regisseur.
er gab sein debüt 2018 mit der single "To My Queen".

tr.who: Tyson Yoshi, Ben Cheng Tsun Yin'in sahne adıdır. Hong Kong'lu bir singer-songwriter ve mv yönetmenidir.
facts: Sahne adı Tyson Yoshi olan Ben Cheng Tsun Yin, bir Hong Kong'lu singer-songwriter ve mv yönetmenidir.
2018'de "To My Queen" adlı single'ıyla debüt yaptı.

nights.title: Andrew Bayer
nights.name: Andrew Bayer
nights.extract: Andrew Michael Bayer is an American DJ and Grammy-nominated music producer. He is best known for working with Anjunabeats as a multi-genre artist and English deep house sublabel Anjunadeep.

en.who: Andrew Michael Bayer is an American dj and Grammy-nominated music producer. He has worked with Anjunabeats as a multi-genre artist.
facts: Andrew Michael Bayer is an American DJ and Grammy-nominated music producer.
He is best known for working with Anjunabeats as a multi-genre artist and English deep house sublabel Anjunadeep.

de.who: Andrew Michael Bayer ist ein amerikanischer dj und Grammy-nominierter musikproduzent. er hat als multi-genre-künstler mit Anjunabeats gearbeitet.
facts: Andrew Michael Bayer ist ein amerikanischer dj und Grammy-nominierter musikproduzent.
er ist vor allem für seine arbeit mit Anjunabeats als multi-genre-künstler und mit Anjunadeep, dem englischen deep-house-sublabel, bekannt.

tr.who: Andrew Michael Bayer amerikalı bir dj ve müzik prodüktörüdür. Anjunabeats ile çok türlü bir sanatçı olarak çalışmıştır.
facts: Andrew Michael Bayer, amerikalı bir dj ve Grammy'ye aday gösterilmiş bir müzik prodüktörüdür.
en çok Anjunabeats ile çok türlü bir sanatçı olarak, İngiliz deep house alt etiketi Anjunadeep ile de çalışmasıyla tanınır.
